scripts.postinstall: dotnet tool restore && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "dotnet run --project api/src/SteeleIT.Api" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.test: dotnet test api/SteeleIT.slnx && npm --prefix web test
scripts.format: dotnet csharpier format . && dotnet format style api/SteeleIT.slnx && dotnet format analyzers api/SteeleIT.slnx && npm --prefix web run format
scripts.lint: dotnet csharpier check . && dotnet format style api/SteeleIT.slnx --verify-no-changes && dotnet format analyzers api/SteeleIT.slnx --verify-no-changes && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix web run typecheck
